# History tools

Undo, redo and the attributed edit history.

1 tools in the `history` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`history`](#history) | Undo or redo edits (by anyone), or list recent history entries with who made them. |

### `history` { #history }

**Undo / redo / log** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Undo or redo edits (by anyone), or list recent history entries with who made them.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | What to do | `undo` `redo` `list` |
| `steps` | integer |  | How many steps for undo/redo (default 1) |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Entries for list (default 20) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    history {"action": "undo"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call history '{"action": "undo"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "history",
        "arguments": {
          "action": "undo"
        }
      }
    }
    ```
